source: Whitehead et al. 2018 Plant Mating Systems Often Vary Widely Among Populations
strict_mapping: reuse existing 2026-08-11 Whitehead contract: source-defined species mean_tm <=0.2 predominantly_selfing; 0.2<mean_tm<0.8 mixed_mating; mean_tm>=0.8 predominantly_outcrossing; source pops>=3
source_review_note: The committed hash-pinned Whitehead supplement provides SpeciesTmData_Whitehead_etal.csv with a source-defined mean_tm and pops count. The repository already accepted 23 Whitehead species as high-quality species-direct mating-system records under this exact mapping and tests the source mean against the population table. Xanthorrhoea johnsonii is the sole current fixed-universe reproductive gap with Whitehead mean_tm and pops>=3: mean_tm=0.95125, pops=4, underlying citation set Zalucki:2013.
formal_integration_policy: cumulative replay of all committed source manifests from the pinned recovered baseline; this batch cannot train genus rules
